hero.title: Emotion Detection
hero.subtitle: A face, a crop, a label.
hero.tagline: A Keras CNN trained on 48×48 grayscale faces, then a webcam loop that finds a face and writes one of seven emotion labels on the frame.
hero.impact: Training and inference are split. datatrain.ipynb fits the network and writes emotion_model.json plus emotion_model.h5. datatest.ipynb loads those files and runs the camera.

embed.label: Preview
embed.title: Try it on your camera.
embed.body: Start the camera, or use the sample photo if the camera is blocked. The page finds a face with the notebook's Haar settings, scale 1.3 and 5 neighbors, then scores a 48×48 gray crop with the saved weights. Pixels are divided by 255, the same rescale the training generator used. Gray, scale, and neighbors are on the preview. The video stays on this page.

problems.d: The label map is angry, disgusted, fear, happy, neutral, sad, and surprised. The last dense layer is a 7-way softmax.
ImageDataGenerator rescales pixels by 1/255 and loads 48×48 grayscale batches of 64 from local train and test folders.
The camera loop uses a frontal-face Haar cascade, crops the box, resizes it to 48×48, and only then calls predict.
Architecture goes to emotion_model.json. Weights go to emotion_model.h5. The test notebook rebuilds the model from those two files.
